name: update_ncr_disposition
description: Update NCR disposition after human approval. Writes to QMS source system, cascades through event pipeline (DDB → MSK → Neptune).

disposition.description: Disposition decision: USE_AS_IS, REWORK, SCRAP, or RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER

name: release_work_order_hold
description: Release a hold on a work order after human approval. Writes to MES source system, cascades through event pipeline.

reason.description: Human-approved rationale for releasing the hold

name: update_supplier_score
description: Update supplier quality score after human approval. Writes to SRM source system, cascades through event pipeline.

reason.description: Human-approved rationale for the score change

name: create_engineering_change
description: Create an Engineering Change Order (ECO) after human approval. Writes to PLM source system, cascades through event pipeline.

part_number.description: Part number affected by the change

change_type.description: Type of change: REVISION, DEVIATION, or CONCESSION

reason.description: Human-approved rationale for the engineering change

name: update_milestone_status
description: Update program milestone risk status after human approval. Writes to Program source system, cascades through event pipeline.

status.description: Risk status: ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, or DELAYED

reason.description: Human-approved rationale for the status change

name: log_maintenance_action
description: Log a fleet maintenance action after human approval. Writes to InService source system, cascades through event pipeline.

reason.description: Human-approved rationale for the maintenance action
